findings.text: Count cache (module-level Map keyed by stringifySequelizeQuery) only invalidated by Book/Podcast afterCreate/afterDestroy hooks (models/Book.js:198-204, Podcast.js:166-170); no afterUpdate hook, so a book/podcast update leaves findAndCountAll returning stale counts indefinitely (no TTL) — correctness hazard.
getUserPermissionBookWhereQuery tag-permission logic copy-pasted verbatim into libraryItemsPodcastFilters.js:24-35 — fixes to permission SQL must be applied in both files.

Five near-identical raw json_each search queries (narrators/tags/genres) differing only in column and result mapping, plus repeated row-mapping for-loops — one parameterized helper would remove the copies.

getFilteredLibraryItems is a ~300-line god-function (filter dispatch, collapse-series exclusion, RSS-feed include, attribute assembly, post-processing all inline); getFilterData in libraryFilters.js:449-~700 is ~250 lines with parallel book/podcast branches re-implementing the same harvesting.
decode() (base64+decodeURIComponent with logged catch returning null) and the searchGroups prefix-parsing duplicated byte-for-byte between libraryFilters and seriesFilters.
Author/narrator/genre listening-time aggregation loops near-identical, same 'audiobook'/'audio book' genre filter copy-pasted.
Inline `process.env.QUERY_PROFILING ? profile(...) : boundMethod` ternaries sprinkled through query code instead of a small wrap helper.
